responsibility: Implements the main machine-description patterns for Intel/Marvell iWMMXt on Arm. It defines the RTL insns for WMMX register moves, scalar↔WMMX transfers, vector arithmetic and logic, broadcasts, alignment/shuffle operations, accumulators, mask extraction, and many other Wireless MMX operations, and then includes iwmmxt2.md to extend the instruction set with the second-generation WMMX2 patterns.
